name: Qnorthwest
address: 1756 Airport Wy S, Seattle, WA 98134, USA

reviews.name: Eric S.
reviews.text: I recently purchased my house and the inspector I hired identified significant issues with the electrical. I was referred to Qnorthwest by a colleague. Joe and Blake assessed my home’s electrical systems professionally, efficiently and thoroughly. My home ended up needing a new electrical panel, wiring for the dryer, and an inspection of all the plug ins. I really appreciated that Joe and Jack shifted their schedules around to allow for the upgrades sooner than later. The day of the panel swap and other upgrades, they brought a positive energy to their work. They took time to do things right resulting in the inspector passing the work on the first go round. Joe and Jack not only knew their trade, but they demonstrated outstanding customer service. Their communication leading up to the job was excellent and I also appreciated how they took time to answer all my questions the day of the job. They will be the first ones I call with any future electrical needs and I will also recommend them to friends, family, and colleagues. Thank you Joe, Jack and Blake for all your efforts!

reviews.name: Randall L.
reviews.text: I have contacted multiple electric companies to help my light fixture in the kitchen issue. They were professional, quick to respond, and very reasonable price. Especially the journey man True done an outstanding job for us.

reviews.name: Blake W.
reviews.text: Joe is the best! Did great work, was great to work with. The team did a great job fitting us into their schedule on short notice, too. Much appreciated all around.

reviews.name: Robert F.
reviews.text:
A Masterclass in Electrical Work!

From the very first interaction, Joe and his entire team set the bar high. The estimate process was clear, fair, and professional — and the execution was nothing short of exceptional. Joe was incredibly patient and thorough, walking me through each step of the project with care and clarity. He answered all my questions thoughtfully, making sure I understood the plan and felt confident in the work being done.

The scope included installing a new outlet for our induction range, setting up a generator inlet, wiring a transfer switch to accommodate a new portable generator, and adding a new outlet in the toilet room. Every element — from the garage setup to the kitchen and even the toilet room — was completed with precision and pride. The workmanship was top-notch, and it’s clear Joe holds himself and his apprentices to a high standard. That kind of integrity and attention to detail is rare.

What impressed me most was Joe’s respect for the space: everything was cleaned up meticulously and restored to its original condition. You can tell he genuinely cares about his craft, the quality of the work, and the learning experience he provides to those working alongside him.

I’ll absolutely be calling Joe again for any future electrical work — and recommending him without hesitation. If you’re looking for someone who combines technical excellence with professionalism and heart, Joe is your guy.

reviews.name: Hui-Ju C.
reviews.text: I used on line chat to make an appointment, it was easy and quick. The electrician - Joe came on time and diagnose the problem right away. Fortunately, it's an easy job that my husband can do it by himself. I didn't hire him this time. But because of this experience, I will definitely call Northwest next time I need an electrician and recommend to others"
